name: Web Hero Centered
description: A centred proposition over a quiet background or a single wide image, with the primary action directly beneath it. One column, one axis, nothing competing for the centre.
spacing: Wide symmetric margins with the headline, body and action stacked on the central axis and generous space above and below the group.
responsive_behavior: The column narrows with the viewport and the headline reflows by line count. The action stays paired with the headline at every width.
